This release introduces a new dedicated release notes page, providing comprehensive historical release information and specific content for various AI providers. It also includes crucial fixes addressing Docker build issues, dashboard authentication problems, and UI inconsistencies, alongside a standard version update.

✨ Features

  • A new dedicated release notes page has been added, featuring backfilled template notes for all v1.x tags, including Anthropic AI-generated content and specific provider tabs for Gemini and Ollama.
